title: The pool's held-out section samples rows of the grown held-out file that no earlier pool held
goal: bench_pool.heldout_section samples at least 20 rows of the grown held-out file lookup_heldout.csv (read only) that name expected articles, none of them a row an earlier pool held, and benchmarks.py pool build --dry-run refuses none

run: import csv, io, subprocess, sys; sys.path.insert(0, "_tools"); import bench_pool; old = subprocess.run(["git", "show", "35b5b7cb2:kb/public/_retrieval/bench_pool.csv"], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout; seen = {r["source"] for r in csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(old)) if r["kind"] == "heldout"}; rows = bench_pool.heldout_section(".", bench_pool.SEED); new = [r for r in rows if r["source"] not in seen]; print("held-out rows:", len(rows), "of them seen before:", len(rows) - len(new)); sys.exit(0 if len(rows) >= 20 and len(new) == len(rows) else 1)

clauses.clause: bench_pool.heldout_section samples at least 20 rows of the grown held-out file lookup_heldout.csv (read only) that name expected articles, none of them a row an earlier pool held

notes: Premise 2026-10-23 on 35b5b7cb2: python3 _tools/benchmarks.py pool build --dry-run exits 1 (pool build: kind heldout: 17 rows, the plan has 20); heldout_section samples 20 of all rows and then drops those with no expect_paths, leaving 17, of which 5 the committed pool already held. The paid build (--ask) and run are ST-fsh6rqnc's, not this story's.
